corridor_notes: Per Zhejiang Development & Reform Commission's official 14th Five-Year Plan for Coal, Petroleum and Natural Gas Development (fzggw.zj.gov.cn, published 2021-07-07 — the same document already cited by a prior researcher for this pipeline), the route is explicitly described as running '乐清登陆站-温州末站，管径1219mm，设计压力10MPa，长度约46公里' (Yueqing Landing Station to Wenzhou [line-end] Station, diameter 1219mm, design pressure 10MPa, length ~46km) — the 46km figure matches GEM's LengthMergedKm=46.00 exactly, strong corroboration this is the correct project. A related (but not confirmed identical) facility was found via a 2023 trade-press article (shifair.com): imported LNG from 浙能温州LNG接收站 (the Zheneng Wenzhou LNG Receiving Terminal, located at 温州市洞头区大门镇小门岛 / Xiaomen Island, Damen Town, Dongtou District) is injected into the Zhejiang provincial gas network via ~26km of external transmission pipeline at a facility called 乐清分输站 (Yueqing Distribution Station) — this may or may not be the same station as '乐清登陆站' named in the FYP document; not confirmed either way.
researcher_notes: Resolution reached at city-level precision only, not station-level, because the exact locations of 乐清登陆站 and 温州末站 could not be pinned down: neither is a mapped OSM place/POI, and the WebSearch tool's session-wide budget was exhausted partway through this task (shared cap consumed by concurrent sibling research agents), forcing reliance on a partially-blocked DuckDuckGo-via-WebFetch workaround that returned no results for either exact station name. If finer precision is needed later, worth trying: (1) the full PDF/report behind the FYP webpage (may have a route map), (2) searching '洞头 华港LNG 北白象分输站' (a different but geographically related Dongtou-to-Beibaixiang line surfaced during this search, in case it shares infrastructure), (3) re-running once WebSearch budget resets.
blockers: Station-level start/end precision not achieved (WebSearch budget exhausted mid-task; alternate search engines blocked/CAPTCHA'd via direct curl). City-level government-building coordinates used as proxies instead, backed by one verified official source (fzggw.zj.gov.cn) that names both stations by name and corroborates the exact 46km length.
